title: 2022 CODATA lists Planck length, mass, time, and temperature with uncertainties
summary: The 2022 listing gives a Planck length, mass, time, and temperature, each with a printed uncertainty.
body:
The 2022 CODATA listing gives four Planck scales, none of them marked exact:

- Planck length: 1.616 255 × 10^−35 m, uncertainty 0.000 018 × 10^−35 m
- Planck mass: 2.176 434 × 10^−8 kg, uncertainty 0.000 024 × 10^−8 kg
- Planck time: 5.391 247 × 10^−44 s, uncertainty 0.000 060 × 10^−44 s
- Planck temperature: 1.416 784 × 10^32 K, uncertainty 0.000 016 × 10^32 K

These are the listing's recommended values. They are not lengths, masses, times, or temperatures that have been read off a laboratory instrument in this card.
